panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Running CANFAR session pods matching the current filters.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct users with at least one running session.

panels.title: Pending sessions
panels.description: Sessions accepted but not yet running: unscheduled, queued, or pulling an image.

panels.title: Queue backlog
panels.description: Workloads Kueue is holding before admission, across all ClusterQueues.

targets.expr: sum(kueue_pending_workloads)

panels.title: CPU committed
panels.description: Fraction of allocatable cores already promised to pod requests.

targets.expr:
sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
/ sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})

panels.title: RAM committed
panels.description: Fraction of allocatable memory already promised to pod requests.

targets.expr:
sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"})
/ sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} == 0)
or vector(0)

panels.title: OOM kills in range
panels.description: Session pods whose last container termination was an OOM kill: users who under-requested memory and lost their work.

panels.title: Active sessions by kind
panels.description: Running sessions split by session type.

panels.title: Session CPU: requested vs used
panels.description: Aggregate CPU held by running sessions against what they actually burn.

panels.title: Active sessions by project
panels.description: Top 15 projects by running session count. Reads empty on the legacy label generation, which had no project dimension.

panels.title: Session memory: requested vs used
panels.description: Aggregate memory held by running sessions against working-set usage.

panels.title: CPU efficiency
panels.description: Used ÷ requested CPU across all running sessions.

panels.title: RAM efficiency
panels.description: Working set ÷ requested memory across all running sessions.

panels.title: CPU efficiency by session kind
panels.description: Working-set CPU divided by requested CPU, for running sessions only. Sustained values under 25% mean the platform is holding capacity that nobody is using.

panels.title: RAM efficiency by session kind
panels.description: Working-set RAM divided by requested RAM, for running sessions only. Sustained values under 25% mean the platform is holding capacity that nobody is using.

panels.title: Session container terminations by reason
panels.description: OOMKilled means the user under-requested memory and lost work. Error means the payload itself failed. Completed is the healthy exit path.

panels.title: Session container restarts
panels.description: Restarts inside session containers. Interactive sessions should essentially never restart.
